title: Complete Follow Market venue minimum-size evidence before FAK intent
author: agent:/root

scope.goal: Correct the verified Follow Market defect in which a fresh executable WebSocket order-book snapshot without venue min_order_size consumes the strategy's only market attempt even though the same attempt can obtain exact CLOB /book evidence.
inScope: Apply only to the exact existing 270 BTC/ETH/SOL 5-minute Follow Market FAK PaperOnly variants with behavior FollowMarketFak.

Before freezing any Follow Market BUY FAK execution intent, accept a fresh executable WebSocket book only when it also contains a positive exact venue MinOrderSize; otherwise, when PaperTakerRestFallbackEnabled=true, fetch the exact CLOB /book for that asset during the same due attempt.

Use the existing per-cycle asset fetch dictionary so each required asset has at most one CLOB /book request even though Follow Market selection, pricing, sizing, and Paper FAK simulation inspect the book more than once.

Use only a positive MinOrderSize returned by the fresh exact CLOB /book for minimum BUY sizing; retain explicit fail-closed rejection when REST is disabled, unavailable, stale, lacks executable asks, or still lacks a positive MinOrderSize.

Preserve the already approved one-attempt-per-strategy/market rule, inclusive threshold, higher-ask outcome selection, tie rejection, 0.99 BUY FAK cap, no cumulative-depth entry gate, Paper fill model, and PaperOnly state.
Add focused regression tests and update the Follow Market execution documentation to identify the REST completion as pre-intent evidence acquisition.
outOfScope: Configured or Gamma market-minimum fallback, substituted/default minimum size, safety multiplier change, configured Paper stake sizing, or any change to the exact venue MinOrderSize formula.

A retry after the strategy's scheduled market attempt, delayed re-evaluation, additional order, changed threshold/direction selection, changed FAK price or fill semantics, or a post-intent order-book revalidation.
Any strategy behavior other than FollowMarketFak, including other FAK families, Maker-GTD, Reference Average, Child, Child ROI, Optimized, Progress, or Follow Leader.

Any catalog, UUID, strategy row, configuration value, schema, migration, historical accounting, settlement, Dashboard, logging, service startup, deployment, Production database/service, Live order, or server-state change.
scope.periodOrFilter: Exact existing 270 Follow Market PaperOnly variants for future due attempts after user-controlled deployment; no historical backfill and no Production mutation.
scope.firstVerification: Inspect the exact FollowMarketFak dispatch path, WebSocket price-change snapshots, CLOB /book parser, per-cycle fetch deduplication, current fallback configuration, focused tests, and Paper/Live parity contract before product edits.

requirements.text: A fresh executable Follow Market WebSocket snapshot without a positive venue MinOrderSize must be completed from exact CLOB /book evidence during the same due attempt before the BUY FAK intent is frozen.
acceptanceCriteria: The exact FollowMarketFak order-book path accepts a fresh executable WebSocket snapshot directly only when MinOrderSize is positive.

When that WebSocket snapshot has missing, null, zero, or negative MinOrderSize and PaperTakerRestFallbackEnabled=true, the same attempt fetches exact CLOB /book evidence for the affected asset before outcome decision/intent creation continues.
A fresh executable REST book with positive MinOrderSize supplies both market evidence and the exact venue minimum used by CreateFollowMarketMinimumStakeSizing.
The shared per-cycle fetch dictionary limits the exact CLOB /book call to one per affected asset across decision, pricing, sizing, and Paper FAK simulation.
No configured or Gamma minimum-size fallback is applied to Follow Market.

verification.command: Run focused BtcUpDown5mPaperStrategyProcessor Follow Market tests in Release with all disposable outputs under the marked D:\CodexTemp run.
verification.expected: Fresh executable cache books without MinOrderSize obtain exact REST books once per affected asset, enter/fill from the REST minimum when all existing predicates pass, and preserve one attempt per strategy/market.

requirements.text: Follow Market must remain fail-closed when exact positive venue minimum-size evidence still cannot be obtained, without changing other strategy families.
acceptanceCriteria: If REST fallback is disabled, the affected WebSocket snapshot is rejected without a REST call and without an order.
If REST is missing, stale, has no executable ask depth, or returns no positive MinOrderSize, the strategy records the corresponding existing explicit rejection and creates no order.
The strategy still records only one terminal attempt for that strategy/market; it does not retry in a later processor pass.
The generic GetFreshTakerOrderBookAsync behavior and every non-FollowMarketFak caller remain unchanged.
No Live order path is enabled or invoked.

verification.command: Run focused success, fail-closed, deduplication, one-attempt, and adjacent non-Follow-Market regression tests in Release under the marked D:\CodexTemp run.
verification.expected: Exact positive REST MinOrderSize succeeds only for Follow Market; missing evidence rejects explicitly; one-attempt and unrelated order-book behavior remain unchanged.

requirements.text: Keep the correction pre-intent, parity-safe, documented, locally verified, and bounded to user-controlled deployment.
acceptanceCriteria: README and PAPER_LIVE_PARITY state that missing venue MinOrderSize in an otherwise fresh executable WebSocket snapshot triggers exact REST evidence acquisition before the immutable intent is frozen.
No newer market data is fetched after intent freeze to resize, reprice, authorize, reject, or roll back that intent.
Focused tests, Release solution build, git diff --check, and WorkingTree/Staged requirement validation pass.
An independent reviewer compares the verbatim request, approved semantic contract, complete diff, and verification evidence and reports PASS with no open finding.

No Production database, service, strategy, order, configuration, deployment, or server state is changed by this task, and disposable artifacts are removed from the marked D:\CodexTemp run before completion.

verification.command: Build PolyCopyTrader.sln in Release with disposable outputs under the marked D:\CodexTemp run; run git diff --check and requirement validation in WorkingTree and Staged modes; obtain independent semantic review.
verification.expected: Build and gates pass, the diff contains only approved paths/semantics, and the reviewer reports no deviation.
